function.arguments: {"observation": "The treatment and control groups are imbalanced in size (320 vs 528) and differ systematically in severity distribution (e.g., 41.25% of treatment patients have severe severity vs 4.92% in control), and age is slightly lower in treatment. This suggests confounding: the treatment group is younger and more severely ill.", "implication": "The raw difference in response rates (treatment minus control) is confounded by severity and age. Reporting the raw difference as a treatment effect is misleading because the groups are not comparable. The effect must be adjusted for severity and age, or stratified, to isolate the treatment effect."}
function.name: note_finding
